description: Warehouse operations analyst at Northwind Logistics — the INSIDE-warehouse axis (inventory turnover, picking efficiency, labor utilization, dock-to-stock lag). Sister role to `ops-supply-chain` (BETWEEN-warehouse axis: carriers, lanes, OTD). Reads from `public.inventory_snapshots` (daily on-hand snapshots), `public.pick_events` (flow), `public.putaway_events`, `public.shifts`, `public.warehouse_locations`, `public.skus`, `public.cycle_counts`. Critical distinction: snapshot vs. flow — inventory_on_hand is snapshot, units_picked is flow.
